family_reports.body: Brian Baron is the head of the alleged corruption

As a teacher and school Principal, I’m in charge of an entire school of children with the teaching credentials from the state of California. My son was kidnapped by family court and medically abused. My son will have lifelong medical complications as a result of the medical abuse. This is why I’m running for public office (Board of Supervisors) to bring reform and justice to family Court!

Family court has destroyed me - as a person who used to see the good in others to the point of emptiness, and my children who were previously thriving are now at varying stages of psychological and emotional dysfunction…
This has destroyed the family, drained us financially and killed extended family due to stress
This system killed my younger son by allowing his drug addicted father and his drug addicted abusive wife unsupervised visits with our son.
